item.title: The Story of the Unicorn
item.description: Long, long ago, there was a unicorn forest with many, many great trees. In the forest lived a mother unicorn and a little unicorn, along with lots and lots of small animals. The mother unicorn had a very beautiful horn growing on her head, and it looked lovely there. Her horn was magical: when a little rabbit got hurt, the mother unicorn touched it with her horn, and the sparkles that fell from the horn landed on the rabbit’s wound, and the rabbit’s injury healed right away.
